name: orb_retest_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: NIFTY's first 15 minutes (09:15-09:30) establishes an opening range whose high and low serve as the primary intraday reference levels for institutional VWAP algorithms, options market makers delta-hedging against gamma exposure accumulated at open, and systematic breakout programs that sized in on the initial move. When NIFTY retests the ORB high (for upside breakouts) or ORB low (for downside breakouts) mid-session, resting limit buy orders from participants who missed the initial breakout and stop-loss orders from trapped directional sellers concentrate at that level, creating a liquidity pool. At 5-second resolution, this absorption is detectable: NIFTY's low dips within 20-25 spot points of the ORB high, forms a micro-range over 60-90 seconds as aggressive sellers hit resting bids, then accelerates sharply away as the absorbed supply is exhausted and momentum programs re-enter in the original breakout direction.

indicators.name: orb_high
indicators.purpose: Opening range high from 09:15-09:30 (180 × 5s bars). NOT scaled — this is a fixed calendar time window; same 15 minutes regardless of bar frequency. The 09:15-09:30 window is the standard institutional opening range for NIFTY, used by VWAP benchmarked programs and options market makers to anchor their intraday reference.

indicators.name: orb_low
indicators.purpose: Opening range low from 09:15-09:30. Same fixed-window logic as orb_high — no scaling needed.

indicators.name: breakout_up_seen
indicators.formula: cumulative_any(close > orb_high, from 09:30 bar onward within session)
indicators.purpose: Cumulative boolean flag: True once NIFTY has closed above ORB high at any point today after 09:30. Required precondition — retest signal only fires if an initial upside breakout has already occurred, confirming the ORB high is now acting as support.

indicators.name: breakout_down_seen
indicators.formula: cumulative_any(close < orb_low, from 09:30 bar onward within session)
indicators.purpose: Same as breakout_up_seen but for downside. Used to ensure single-direction breakout day — on whipsaw days when both levels break, we skip signals to avoid false retests.

indicators.name: near_orb_high_24
indicators.formula: any(low[i-24:i] is within proximity_pct of orb_high)
indicators.purpose: 24-bar (2 minute) rolling window detecting whether NIFTY's intrabar low has recently touched within proximity_pct of the ORB high. 24 bars chosen because ORB retests on NIFTY form over 60-90 seconds — enough history to capture the approach without catching stale touches from hours earlier.

indicators.name: near_orb_low_24
indicators.formula: any(high[i-24:i] is within proximity_pct of orb_low)
indicators.purpose: Mirror of near_orb_high_24 for downside retests. Same 24-bar window captures the 60-90 second micro-range formation at the ORB low.

indicators.name: momentum_3
indicators.purpose: 15-second momentum (3 × 5s bars) to confirm directional bounce off the ORB level. Deliberately short — we want the immediate acceleration after absorption, not a trend measure. Positive = bouncing off ORB high; negative = rejecting at ORB low.

conditions: breakout_up_seen == True (upside breakout confirmed earlier this session)
near_orb_high_24 == True (NIFTY low touched within proximity_pct of ORB high in last 2 min)
close >= orb_high (current bar closes above ORB high — level held as support)
momentum_3 > 0 (positive 15-second momentum — bouncing off the level)
buy_ce.confirmation: Close above ORB high on current bar with positive 15s momentum, after low touched within proximity of level in prior 2 minutes

conditions: breakout_down_seen == True (downside breakout confirmed earlier this session)
near_orb_low_24 == True (NIFTY high touched within proximity_pct of ORB low in last 2 min)
close <= orb_low (current bar closes below ORB low — level held as resistance)
buy_pe.confirmation: Close below ORB low on current bar with negative 15s momentum, after high touched within proximity of level in prior 2 minutes

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option points (~8 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5). A valid ORB retest-and-hold should not see NIFTY retrace more than 8 spot points against position in the first 30-90 seconds — if it does, the ORB level has failed as support/resistance and the thesis is wrong. Calibrated to the 15-second typical NIFTY move of 1-3 pts: a 4-pt option stop gives ~2 standard deviations of 15s moves before triggering.
exit.stop_rationale_for_target: 7 option points (~14 NIFTY spot points). First impulse after ORB retest confirmation on NIFTY typically covers 15-25 spot points in the original breakout direction as momentum re-accelerates. Targeting 14 pts captures ~60-70% of the expected first leg at 1:1.75 R:R, avoiding the fade that often occurs as the move matures.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option points = ~14 NIFTY spot points. Based on 30-90 second typical NIFTY moves of 5-10 option points after a confirmed level hold, 7 pts targets the median outcome at 1:1.75 risk-reward.
exit.eod_rule: flatten at 14:30 IST — retests after 14:30 reflect end-of-day positioning, not genuine institutional reference level tests

filters.vix_filter: none — ORB retest logic is self-contained; the level-hold mechanism works across VIX regimes as long as initial breakout occurred
filters.time_filter: 09:30-14:30 IST only; retests before 09:30 are impossible (ORB still forming), after 14:30 are late-day noise
filters.volume_filter: none at 5s level — index volume is too noisy for reliable filtering at this frequency
filters.trend_filter: single-direction breakout only (breakout_up XOR breakout_down); whipsaw days excluded to avoid false retest signals
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at close prices

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — ORB retest at 1-min bars is well-documented; the 5s micro-bounce entry is novel and less competed, but crowding risk grows if ORB strategies proliferate at HFT scale

adaptation_notes: Original strategy: NIFTY 50 constituent stocks, 1-min bars, 20-120 minute hold, retest identified 1-3 hours after breakout. Three key adaptations: (1) Universe: individual stocks → NIFTY index. ORB retest is MORE reliable on the index because institutional VWAP programs explicitly use NIFTY's ORB as a reference level — every participant tracks it, concentrating liquidity at retests. (2) Hold time: 20-120 min → 30-90 seconds. We trade the microstructure reaction (first impulse after absorption) rather than the full continuation move. This requires much tighter stops and targets calibrated to 15-30 second NIFTY move magnitudes. (3) Entry precision: original used 1-min confirmation bar; at 5s we can detect the micro-bounce onset (close above level + positive 15s momentum after touching within 25 pts) rather than waiting a full minute. The 5s resolution is the structural advantage here — we enter closer to the actual inflection point.
weaknesses: NIFTY ORB retests occur 1-4 times per session on qualifying days — low frequency means only 1-4 trades/day maximum, reducing statistical power in backtests
Single-direction filter (no whipsaw days) eliminates signal on range-bound days when both ORB levels are briefly breached — correctly avoids these but reduces trade count
2-minute proximity window may trigger entry during initial approach before retest completes, leading to early entries that get stopped before the actual bounce
Gap days where NIFTY opens well above/below ORB levels from prior session may compress ORB range to near-zero, making proximity thresholds unreliable

_source.original_target: session high at retest time + 0.5 * ORB_range
